# ZapSMTP

> Email API and SMTP relay: send, receive and track email.

- Base URL: `https://api.zapsmtp.com/v1`. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <API key>`; JSON in and out.
- Test keys (`zap_test_…`) run the whole pipeline without delivering anything; send to `delivered@simulator.zapsmtp.com` (and the other [simulator addresses](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/testing.md)) to see each outcome.
- SDKs for Node.js, Python, PHP (and Laravel), Go, Ruby (and Rails), Java and .NET: https://zapsmtp.com/docs/sdks.md
- Keep API keys on the server. Sends take an `Idempotency-Key`; retry 429 and 5xx answers with backoff, honouring `Retry-After`.
- Errors: `{"statusCode", "name", "message", "error": {"code", "message", "type"}}`. OpenAPI 3.1: https://zapsmtp.com/openapi.json
- Every page below is Markdown; all of them in one file: https://zapsmtp.com/llms-full.txt

## Get started

- [Quickstart](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/index.md): Send your first email with the ZapSMTP API in minutes: keys, live code examples in eight languages, test mode and the full API reference.
- [Dashboard tour](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/dashboard.md): A tour of the ZapSMTP dashboard: sending health, every email with its delivery timeline, domains, API keys, webhooks, inbound email and suppressions.
- [SDKs and OpenAPI](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/sdks.md): Official ZapSMTP libraries for Node.js, Python, PHP, Laravel, Go, Ruby, Java and .NET, and the OpenAPI 3.1 description of the whole API.
- [AI tools](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/ai-tools.md): Use ZapSMTP from AI coding assistants: the MCP server for Claude, Cursor and VS Code, Agent Skills, llms.txt with every page as Markdown, and the CLI.
- [Recipes](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/recipes.md): Copy-paste ZapSMTP recipes: password resets, receipts with PDFs, drip series, newsletters, bounce webhooks, support inbox, magic links, retries.
- [Migrating to ZapSMTP](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/migration.md): Move from Resend, SendGrid, Mailgun, Postmark or Amazon SES: field and event mappings, templates, webhooks, suppressions, DNS and a safe rollout.

## Sending

- [Sending email](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/sending.md): Send email with the ZapSMTP API: addresses, HTML and text, attachments, headers, tags, idempotency, scheduling, batches, streams and retries.
- [Domains & DNS setup](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/domain-setup.md): Publish DKIM, SPF and DMARC for ZapSMTP at any DNS provider, verify the domain, roll out DMARC and add your logo in the inbox.
- [Templates and variables](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/templating.md): ZapSMTP template language: escaping, sections, lists, typed variables with defaults, global variables, previews, publishing, versions and sending by template id or alias.
- [Email template editor](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/template-editor.md): Design emails in the ZapSMTP visual editor or write the HTML yourself: a gallery of ready templates, drag-and-drop blocks, live preview, versions, and sending by template id.
- [SMTP relay](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/smtp.md): Connect any mailer to ZapSMTP over SMTP: host, ports, TLS, credentials and examples for Node.js, Python, PHP, Go, Ruby, Laravel and Django.

## Events & data

- [Webhook events](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/webhook-events.md): ZapSMTP webhook event types, payloads, retries and HMAC-SHA256 signature verification with code for Node.js, Python, PHP, Go and Ruby.
- [Click actions](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/click-actions.md): Name the buttons and links in ZapSMTP emails: tell clicks apart with data-zap-action, receive email.clicked with the action, send each action to its own webhook endpoint.
- [Tracking and analytics](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/analytics.md): Follow every ZapSMTP email from acceptance to click: statuses, open and click tracking, timelines, metrics by domain, tag or provider, and alerts.
- [Receiving email](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/inbound-guide.md): Receive email with ZapSMTP: managed or own-domain addresses, routes, signed webhooks, parsed replies, attachments, conversations and replies.

## Operations

- [Deliverability guide](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/deliverability.md): Reach the inbox with ZapSMTP: Gmail, Yahoo and Microsoft sender rules, DKIM and DMARC, one-click unsubscribe, warm-up, suppressions and monitoring.
- [Testing & simulator](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/testing.md): Test every delivery path with ZapSMTP test keys and simulator addresses: bounces, complaints, delays and exact SMTP replies.
- [Errors, limits & paging](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/conventions.md): ZapSMTP API conventions: API keys, error format and codes, rate limits, quotas, idempotency and pagination.
- [Teams & client accounts](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/teams.md): Work on many ZapSMTP accounts with one login: client accounts for agencies, invites, roles and access that ends the moment someone is removed.

## API reference

- [Emails](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/emails.md): Send, schedule, batch and inspect email through the ZapSMTP API.
- [Domains](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/domains.md): Add and verify sending domains; tracking, reply tracking, brand and reputation.
- [Webhooks](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/webhooks.md): Receive signed delivery events, inspect attempts, replay and rotate secrets.
- [Click actions](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/actions.md): Named buttons and links: tell clicks apart, describe them and see their activity.
- [Templates](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/templates.md): Store email templates with Mustache variables and render previews.
- [Variables](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/variables.md): The variable catalogue and the account’s global variables ({{global.key}}).
- [Modules, images & timers](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/template-library.md): Saved modules, template images and countdown timers for the visual template editor.
- [Received emails](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/receiving.md): Read inbound email: bodies, headers, authentication results and attachments.
- [Inbound setup](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/inbound.md): Inbound addresses on managed or own domains, routing rules and stats.
- [Suppressions](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/suppressions.md): Addresses ZapSMTP will not send to: hard bounces, complaints, unsubscribes.
- [Statistics](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/stats.md): Delivery totals, time series, provider / bounce breakdowns and metrics by domain, stream or tag.
- [Keys & SMTP credentials](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/keys.md): Create and revoke API keys and per-application SMTP credentials.
- [Logs & usage](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/logs.md): Every API request with its bodies, and this month’s usage against your plan.
- [Simulator & IPs](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/platform.md): Simulator addresses for testing and your dedicated sending IPs.

## Optional

- [Declare an action — Click actions API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/actions/create-action.md): Declare an action and describe it. Optional: links work with any valid name, declared or not.

- [Retrieve an action — Click actions API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/actions/get-action.md): Retrieve one action from the catalogue, with its activity and where it is used.

- [Describe an action — Click actions API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/actions/update-action.md): Change an action’s description. An action that links use but nobody declared is declared by this call.
- [Check reputation now — Domains API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/domains/check-domain-reputation.md): Run a blocklist check of the domain now and return its reputation.
- [Add a domain — Domains API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/domains/create-domain.md): Add a sending domain; returns the DNS records to publish.
- [Delete a domain — Domains API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/domains/delete-domain.md): Delete a sending domain.
- [DMARC reports — Domains API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/domains/domain-dmarc.md): DMARC aggregate reports about the domain: the address to publish in your DMARC record and what mailbox providers reported.
- [Domain reputation — Domains API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/domains/domain-reputation.md): Blocklist (DNSBL) status of a sending domain.
- [Retrieve brand settings — Domains API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/domains/get-brand.md): Brand-in-the-inbox status: sender name, BIMI logo/certificate, DMARC enforcement and per-provider readiness.

- [List logs — Logs & usage API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/logs/list-logs.md): List the API requests made with your keys, newest first. Bodies are on Retrieve a log. Entries appear within seconds and are kept for your plan’s log reten
- [Retrieve usage — Logs & usage API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/logs/usage.md): This month’s sending against your plan: emails sent, included volume, limit, overage and, on the Free plan, today’s count.

- [Totals — Statistics API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/stats/stats.md): Event counts by status over the last N hours (live traffic only).

- [Remove a suppression — Suppressions API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/suppressions/delete-suppression.md): Remove an address from the suppression list.

- [Publish a template — Templates API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/templates/publish-template.md): Make the current draft the version sends use. Until a template is published, sending with it fails.
- [Render unsaved source — Templates API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/templates/render-source.md): Validate and preview unsaved template source.
- [Render a template — Templates API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/templates/render-template.md): Preview a stored template with given variables (defaults to its sample variables).
- [Restore a version — Templates API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/templates/restore-template-version.md): Copy a version back into the draft. Publishing stays a separate step.
- [Update a template — Templates API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/templates/update-template.md): Update a template (partial).
- [Delete a global variable — Variables API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/variables/delete-global-variable.md): Delete a global variable. Sends with a template that still uses it then fail with 422 template_render_error until it is set again.
- [List variables — Variables API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/variables/list-variables.md): The variable catalogue: every variable the account’s templates can use, with where each is used. System variables first, then global ones, then template va
- [Set a global variable — Variables API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/variables/put-global-variable.md): Create or replace a global variable. Every template that uses it renders the new value from the next send on.
- [Create a webhook — Webhooks API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/webhooks/create-webhook.md): Create a webhook endpoint; the signing secret is returned.
- [Delete a webhook — Webhooks API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/webhooks/delete-webhook.md): Delete a webhook endpoint.
- [Retrieve an event — Webhooks API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/webhooks/get-webhook-event.md): One event with its payload and every delivery attempt, oldest first.
- [Retrieve a webhook — Webhooks API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/webhooks/get-webhook.md): Retrieve a webhook endpoint including its signing secret.
- [List events — Webhooks API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/webhooks/list-webhook-events.md): Events sent to this endpoint, newest first, each with its outcome and number of attempts (from the endpoint’s last 100 delivery attempts).
- [List webhooks — Webhooks API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/webhooks/list-webhooks.md): List webhook endpoints (newest first); secrets are omitted.
- [Replay an event — Webhooks API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/webhooks/replay-event.md): Re-send a past event (from the last 100 deliveries) to the endpoint now.
- [Rotate the signing secret — Webhooks API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/webhooks/rotate-secret.md): Generate a new signing secret; the old one stays valid for 24 hours.
- [Send a test event — Webhooks API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/webhooks/test-webhook.md): Send a signed sample event to the endpoint now and report the result.
- [Update a webhook — Webhooks API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/webhooks/update-webhook.md): Update a webhook's URL, events, click-action filter or enabled state.
- [List delivery attempts — Webhooks API](https://zapsmtp.com/docs/webhooks/webhook-deliveries.md): List the last 100 delivery attempts of a webhook (newest first).
- [Pricing](https://zapsmtp.com/pricing/): plans and overage.
